units: Men. 42ᵃ אין ציצית אלא ע׳ tsitsith (Num. XV, 38, sq.) means locks (fringes), as we read (Ez. VIII, 3) &c. Sifra Emor, Par. 12, ch. XVI (ref. to עץ עבת, Lev. XXIII, 40) את שעֲנַף עצו דומה וכ׳ (not עצן), v. עָבוֹת; Pesik. Ul’kaḥ., p. 183ᵇ עץ שע׳ עצו (corr. acc.).—Pl. עֲנָפִים.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32b:17">Succ. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>שעֲנָפָיו חופין וכ׳</he>; Y. ib. III, 53ᶜ bot., v. <cite ref="P00035"><he>עָבוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>ענפיו חופות וכ׳</he> its (the Zargunah’s) foliage covers the largest portion of it, but forms no veil; a. e.
